query_transform_independence.non_adaptive_panel: query list frozen before transform generation or reveal
query_transform_independence.adaptive_panel: separate threat-model audit; no per-query theorem claim unless a proof covers adaptive interaction
query_transform_independence.note: Commit/reveal is an audit control, not proof that operational queries are independent of the hidden transform.

audit_planning.method: zero-failure one-sided exact binomial upper bound
limitations: These are audit planning counts, not proof of an algorithmic theorem.
Use an exact binomial upper limit when failures are observed.
Do not pool across query strata to claim a per-query guarantee.
Predeclare multiplicity control across strata and simultaneous claims.

exact_invariants: Every exact candidate is fully scored or safely pruned by an independently admissible conservative bound.
Approximate candidate coverage and exact reranking are measured separately.
A statistical interval cannot authorize deterministic exact pruning.
A checksum does not prove the truth of a residual bound.
Uncertain or threshold-equal bounds continue scoring unless the canonical stable-ID tie rule proves exclusion.
IncompleteOrUncertified never promotes to a completed guarantee class.

promotion_targets.target: 100% canonical oracle agreement; zero false pruning
tau >= 0.99, delta <= 0.01 per fixed query under reviewed proof and assumptions
tau >= 0.999, delta <= 0.001 only if practical and proven
predeclared held-out risk and valid finite-sample upper confidence limit; not a theorem
